sumber: Units following the Year 5 English textbook (Starter + 8 units)

nota.t: Key words: be (am/is/are), have got, question words: what, where, when, who, why, how.
Key words: library, museum, hospital, mosque, train station, there is / there are, near, far from.

baris: in, on, under, behind, next to, between
at 7 o'clock, on Monday, in June, in 2025

nota.t: Key words: get up, have breakfast, go to school, do homework, go to bed, while, when.
For an action in progress in the past: I was reading when the phone rang. (was / were + verb-ing)
Key words: habitat, rainforest, endangered, protect, Malayan tiger, hornbill, turtle.

t: balanced diet, exercise, enough sleep, clean water, wash your hands
fever, cough, sore throat, stomachache, headache
reduce, reuse, recycle, pollution, litter, endangered animals, rainforest

nota.t: Key words: subjects: Science, Maths, History, Art, PE, must / mustn't, have to, library, project.
After a modal, use the base verb: She can swim (not swims).
Key words: balanced diet, vitamins, exercise, sleep, because, so.

baris: I stayed home because I was sick.
Although it was late, she kept reading.

nota.t: Sequence words: first, next, then, after that, finally.
Key words: badminton, football, athletics, score a goal, win / lose, quickly, well, hard.
as ... as: Ali is as tall as Abu. Comparative + than: A cheetah is faster than a lion.
Key words: baby, toddler, child, teenager, adult, used to, when I was younger.
Key words: holiday, pack, suitcase, hotel, will, be going to, plan.

baris: We are going to visit Melaka next week.
